speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma.

Your significant risk factors of age, long-term smoking, and previous abdominal pain, combined with painless jaundice and weight loss, strongly point to a malignancy of the biliary tree. I need to confirm this immediately; please have a CT abdomen with contrast and an MRCP performed to visualize the bile ducts.
